1.title: Cloud and On-Premise Infrastructure Lead
1.description: Experience working with more than 50 applications across Development, QA, and Production environments, contributing to deployments, database administration, and REST API integration. Implemented solutions using Docker, Docker Compose, Apache, Nginx, and AWS, complementing application development and operations with automation, monitoring, and cybersecurity practices.

Automated processes using PowerShell and supported applications running on Windows and Linux servers, complemented by administration of VMware, Hyper-V, Active Directory, and corporate networks.

1.p1: Hi! I'm Juan Esteban Restrepo Ossa
1.p2: I am a Systems Engineer and technology professional with experience in software development, Cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity. Throughout my career, I have worked on the administration and evolution of technology platforms, participating in projects involving both software development and application operations.
1.p3: My professional experience has allowed me to work for 9 years in Cloud and On-Premise environments, mainly with technologies such as AWS, Linux, Windows, VMware, Docker, and automation, while strengthening my development skills using JavaScript, PHP, Node.js, Vue.js, React, and REST APIs.
1.p4: I am currently focused on continuing to grow in software development, creating web applications and solutions that combine programming best practices, service integration, databases, and Cloud technologies.
1.p5: One of the strengths of my profile is my ability to understand an application from the code to the infrastructure where it runs. This perspective allows me to develop solutions while considering aspects such as performance, security, availability, deployment, and scalability.
1.p6: My goal is to continue growing as a software developer, leveraging my experience in infrastructure, Cloud, and DevOps to build useful, secure, and scalable technology solutions.
